_comment: Third-party charts the platform installs, pinned to an exact version and
installed in this order by scripts/cluster-up.mjs. Nothing is installed from
an unpinned `helm install` in a script or a README, so the rehearsal cluster
and the graded demo get identical components.
kube-prometheus-stack comes first: its CRDs (ServiceMonitor, PrometheusRule)
must exist before any other chart or manifest declares one.

charts.why: Prometheus, Alertmanager and Grafana, run by the Prometheus Operator, with kube-state-metrics and node-exporter for what Kubernetes and the nodes are doing.
Turns Ingress objects into a real HTTP entry point on 80/443.
Supplies the CPU readings the HorizontalPodAutoscaler scales on.
Stores the logs of the pods, searchable in Grafana by label and by request ID.
Reads the application and ingress logs through the Kubernetes API, parses their JSON, and sends them to Loki.
